```powershell
Write-Output '=== COUNTESS MATERIAL CENSUS + REPAIR + RECOOK - BOTH GAMES, ONE JOB (Tyree 2026-10-27 23:52 MDT, from his own screen: And she is grey. The Countess renders GREY in the packaged games - the engine default where a material should be. Census and repair in one motion per the anti-stall protocol: for each project, list the Countess skeletal mesh assets, print every material slots material path; any slot that is empty or the default WorldGrid/Default material gets repaired with a real material found in the meshs own folder, saved in place. Then both games recook Win64 and the standalone proof runs, grepping for material warnings alongside the census and move test. Runs behind the 321/322 ground repairs in the same queue, so the final packages carry floor and color together. Editor-closed guard on.) ==='
$waited = 0
while ((Get-Process UnrealEditor -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -and $waited -lt 8) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 15; $waited++ }
if (Get-Process UnrealEditor -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Write-Output 'EDITOR STILL OPEN after 2 min - material job deferred, nothing touched.'; Write-Output 'MATERIAL JOB DEFERRED'; return }
$py = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([System.Convert]::FromBase64String(''))
$cmdexe = 'C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.8\Engine\Binaries\Win64\UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe'
$uat = 'C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.8\Engine\Build\BatchFiles\RunUAT.bat'
foreach ($g in @(@('VEIL','D:\VEIL','D:\Builds\VEIL\VEIL_DONE','VEIL.exe'), @('OMNI','D:\OMNI-UE','D:\Builds\OMNI\OMNI_DONE','OMNI.exe'))) {
  $name = $g[0]; $proj = $g[1]; $arch = $g[2]; $exename = $g[3]
  "##### $name #####" | Write-Output
  Set-Content "$proj\Saved\phi_material_census.py" -Value $py -Encoding UTF8
  $uproj = Get-ChildItem $proj -Filter '*.uproject' -File | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName
  & $cmdexe $uproj -run=pythonscript -script="$proj\Saved\phi_material_census.py" -unattended -nopause -nosplash *> "$proj\Saved\materialcensus323.log"
  Select-String -Path "$proj\Saved\materialcensus323.log" -Pattern 'PHI MATERIAL|Error:' | Select-Object -Last 20 | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim() } | Write-Output
  $cooklog = "$proj\Saved\materialcook323.log"
  $p = Start-Process $uat -ArgumentList @('BuildCookRun', "-project=$uproj", '-noP4', '-platform=Win64', '-clientconfig=Development', '-build', '-cook', '-stage', '-pak', '-archive', "-archivedirectory=$arch") -Wait -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden -RedirectStandardOutput $cooklog -RedirectStandardError "$cooklog.err"
  "UAT exit: $($p.ExitCode)" | Write-Output
  Select-String -Path $cooklog -Pattern 'BUILD SUCCESSFUL|BUILD FAILED|AutomationTool exiting|Error:' | Select-Object -Last 5 | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim() } | Write-Output
  $exe = "$arch\Windows\$exename"
  if (Test-Path $exe) { $fi = Get-Item $exe; "exe modified $($fi.LastWriteTime.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'))" | Write-Output
    $proc = Start-Process $exe -ArgumentList @('-PhiStandaloneProof') -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 40
    $logs = Get-ChildItem "$proj\Saved\Logs", "$arch\Windows\$name\Saved\Logs" -Filter '*.log' -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1
    if ($logs) { Select-String -Path $logs.FullName -Pattern 'PHI CENSUS|PHI MOVE TEST|Material|material' | Select-Object -Last 10 | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim() } | Write-Output } else { Write-Output 'NO PROOF LOG FOUND' }
    Get-Process $name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  } else { Write-Output 'EXE MISSING AFTER MATERIAL COOK' }
}
Write-Output 'MATERIAL JOB DONE'
```
